gloss: unless it is; if not; otherwise

definitions.gloss: unless it is; if it isn't
definitions.explanation: After a noun or na-adjective: the condition "if it is not ~". The casual spoken form of でなければ; じゃ is the contraction of では.
At the start of a sentence: "if not (what was just said)", introducing the alternative or the consequence. Casual speech.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧じゃなければ⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: If it isn't raining, I'll go.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暇|ひま}→暇：00592_hima⟧じゃなければ⟦{手伝|てつだ}って→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧。
examples.english: If you're not busy, give me a hand.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日曜日|にちようび}→日曜日：00656_nichiyoubi⟧じゃなければ、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{混|こ}んでいない→混む：02574_komu⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: Unless it's a Sunday, this shop isn't that crowded.

examples.japanese: じゃなければ、⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{寝|ね}→寝る：00470_neru⟧な⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。じゃなければ⟦{起|お}きられない→起きる：00521_okiru⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: Go to bed early. Otherwise you won't be able to get up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電話|でんわ}して→電話する：05652_denwasuru⟧みて。じゃなければ、⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}して→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧。
examples.english: Try phoning. If that doesn't work, get in touch by email or something.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- [noun]じゃなければ〜⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: unless it is ~, (it) cannot ~
- [noun]じゃなければ⟦だめ→だめ：00693_dame⟧: it has to be ~
- じゃなければ、〜 (sentence-initial): otherwise ~

SIMILAR WORDS:
- でなければ: the neutral form, used in writing and careful speech
- じゃ⟦なきゃ→ない：01118_nai⟧: an even more casual contraction
- ⟦じゃないと→じゃないと：30683_janaito⟧: very close; sounds more like a warning of a bad result

WATCH OUT:
- After a verb the form is 〜⟦なければ→ない：01118_nai⟧ (⟦{行|い}かなければ→行く：00119_iku⟧), not じゃなければ.
